svg.title: HOMEBOUND study area in Gale Crater
svg.desc: Actual NASA Mars Trek MGS/MOLA regional color-shaded relief, north up. The orange footprint locates the approximately 1.52 kilometre study area near 137.35 degrees east, 5.19 degrees south. The larger locator ring is for visibility, not a route.
svg.metadata: {"source": "Mars_MGS_MOLA_ClrShade_merge_global_463m", "credit": "NASA Mars Trek / NASA MGS-MOLA", "processing": "Cropped WMTS source tiles, geographic grid and georeferenced study-area locator. No synthetic terrain or new spatial detail."}

g.text: Locator ring: study area, not a walking route.
NASA Mars Trek / NASA MGS-MOLA | Source spacing about 463 m
Source relief with a cropped view and HOMEBOUND study-area annotation.
